elements.manual_reason: Mouse cursor sweeps up the idea list into the sidebar; it ends just above-left of b03 (an OCR fragment of 'Effort'), and no candidate box covers the pointer itself.
elements.label: Mouse cursor

pattern.description: The cursor sweeps upward through the All Ideas table into the left sidebar; each idea row lights up with a hover tint (and a drag handle, with the title truncated) as the pointer passes, and the sidebar's All Ideas item shows its more-actions button when the cursor reaches the sidebar.
pattern.why_premium: Hover states follow the pointer row by row, so the camera stays still while the eye is led from the table to the views list in step with the voiceover ('The ideas you've gathered can be organised'), setting up the switch to another view.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to(cursor,{x:-330,y:-280,duration:0.33,ease:'power2.inOut'}); rows hover via a timeline of tl.set(row[i],{backgroundColor:'#F4F5F7'}) / tl.set(row[i-1],{backgroundColor:'transparent'}) with stagger:-0.03 (bottom to top) synced to the cursor's y; at the end tl.fromTo(moreBtn,{autoAlpha:0},{autoAlpha:1,duration:0.1}).
build_hint.remotion: Cursor position = interpolate(frame,[0,10],[start,end],{easing:Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); compute the hovered row from cursor y each frame and apply its background tint (no easing, instant hover); more-actions button opacity = cursor in sidebar ? 1 : 0.

notes: Screen recording with no camera move; the row hover states are instant swaps, and b02 (union of the Summary column rows) stands in for all of them. Cursor uses manual_box because no candidate covers it.
